topic: The forest where no animal has willingly entered in over 100 years
hook: No animal will enter this forest. Not for 100 years.
script: No animal will enter this forest. Not for 100 years. The Hoia-Baciu forest in Romania is known as the world's most haunted forest. Animals refuse to enter. Trees grow in perfect spirals for no botanical reason. Visitors report intense anxiety, nausea and temporary amnesia. Photographs taken inside show faces that weren't there when the photo was taken. Scientists have studied it for decades. No rational explanation exists. Follow for real locations that defy logic.
